verdict.rationale: three.js is code-first, so its documented JavaScript API lets an agent create scenes, cameras and objects and set their properties programmatically (gh-4/gh-5). The probe confirms coding agents drive the library directly through npm, with llms.txt and llms-full.txt as the machine-readable docs path. However, the three.js editor (docs-7) has no evidenced scriptable or automation interface, there is no MCP or API endpoint, and nothing covers triggering builds. missing for 10: documented programmatic control of the editor, build/export triggering, an agent-facing automation interface such as MCP or an editor command API, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven workflows.
